relicDesc.cn: 结算时，若你的手牌数≥4，为每张手牌随机赋予一种附术。
relicDesc.en: AT TALLY: If your hand has ≥ 4 cards, each card in your hand gains a random foil.

relicDesc.cn:
点数上限-5
抽牌时，所有玩家本轮点数上限+2。
relicDesc.en:
Limit -5
AT DRAW: All players gain Limit +2 (this round).

relicDesc.cn:
额外点数+2
结算时，你的手牌每有5张牌，本轮额外点数+2，获得2巫术金块。
relicDesc.en:
Bonus +2
AT TALLY: For every 5 cards in your hand, Bonus +2 (this round), Witchgeld +2.

relicDesc.cn: 抽牌时，向你的牌库中洗入1张点数为3并带有随机附术的临时牌。
relicDesc.en: AT DRAW: Shuffle 1 temporary number card [3] with a random foil into the deck.

relicDesc.cn:
抽牌时，若抽到手牌中已有的点数，本轮额外点数+1。
若未抽到手牌中已有的点数，本轮点数上限+1。
relicDesc.en:
AT DRAW: If the rank of the drawn card is equal to a card in your hand, Bonus +1 (this round).
IF NOT: Limit +1 (this round).

relicDesc.cn: 结算时，若你的手牌达到上限（15张），本轮额外点数+10。
relicDesc.en: AT TALLY: If your hand is maxed (15 cards), Bonus +10 (this round).

relicDesc.cn:
抽牌时，若这张牌是点数<5的数字牌，获得1巫术金块。
若这张牌是点数≥5的数字牌，使这张牌点数-1。
relicDesc.en:
AT DRAW: If the drawn card is a number card that has < 5 pips, Witchgeld +1.
If the drawn card is a number card that has ≥ 5 pips, apply Pip -1 to it.

relicDesc.cn:
点数上限+2，并获得1张点数为10，且带有随机附术的牌。
进入巫术商店时，再次发动此效果。
relicDesc.en:
Limit +2 and get a [10] card with a random foil.
AT SHOPPE VISIT: Trigger this effect again.

relicDesc.cn:
点数上限+5
抽牌时，若这张牌是数字牌，你的点数+10。
relicDesc.en:
Limit +5
AT DRAW: If a number card is drawn, Points +10.

relicDesc.cn:
每轮开始时，获得9巫术金块。
抽牌时，失去2巫术金块。
relicDesc.en:
AT ROUND START: Witchgeld +9.
AT DRAW: Witchgeld -2.

relicDesc.cn:
点数上限+3
每轮开始时，将你牌库中最大的数字牌复制到所有其他玩家的牌库。
relicDesc.en:
Limit +3
AT ROUND START: Copy the highest ranked number card in your deck and add it to the decks of all other players.

relicDesc.cn:
点数上限+25
抽牌时，本轮点数上限-5。
relicDesc.en:
Limit +25
AT DRAW: Limit -5 (this round).

relicDesc.cn: 抽牌时，若这张牌是数字牌，且点数≥8，本轮点数上限+4。
relicDesc.en: AT DRAW: If a number card with ≥ 8 pips is drawn, Limit +4 (this round).

relicDesc.cn: 抽牌导致爆牌时，恢复1萝卜点，点数上限+2，获得3巫术金块（每轮限1次）。
relicDesc.en: AT DRAW: If a bust is triggered, restore 1 Carrot, Limit +2, Witchgeld +3 (effect only applies 1 time per round).

relicDesc.cn:
结算时，若你的手牌有≥2张肖像牌，本轮额外点数+3，获得3巫术金块。
若没有，将你牌库中随机1张牌变为随机肖像牌。
relicDesc.en:
AT TALLY: If your hand has ≥ 2 court cards, Bonus +3 (this round), Witchgeld +3.
IF NOT: Change 1 random card in your deck to a random court card.

relicDesc.cn:
每轮开始时，若你的牌库中只有肖像牌，每有1张，本轮额外点数+1。
获得该祝福时，删除2张非肖像牌。
relicDesc.en:
AT ROUND START: If your deck only has court cards, for every 1 court card in your deck, Bonus +1 (this round).
WHEN THIS BOON IS ACQUIRED: Remove 2 non-court cards.

relicDesc.cn:
结算时，你的手牌每有1张肖像牌，获得2巫术金块。
获得该祝福时，获得2张带有随机附术的肖像牌。
relicDesc.en:
AT TALLY: For every 1 court card in your hand, Witchgeld +2.
WHEN THIS BOON IS ACQUIRED: Get 2 court cards with random foils.

relicDesc.cn: 抽牌导致爆牌时，若点数超出点数上限≥9点，本轮点数上限+10（每轮限1次）。
relicDesc.en: AT DRAW: If a bust exceeding the Limit by ≥ 9 is triggered, Limit +10 (this round only; effect only applies 1 time per round).

relicDesc.cn:
抽牌时，若你连续抽到肖像牌，本轮额外点数+3。
若它无附术，额外赋予这张牌附术·黄金。
relicDesc.en:
AT DRAW: When you consecutively draw another court card, Bonus +3 (this round).
If the said card is unfoiled, grant it the Geld foil.

relicDesc.cn: 结算时，若你的手牌恰好为一张J、一张Q和一张K，将你的点数变为66，并恢复2萝卜点。
relicDesc.en: AT TALLY: If your hand consists of exactly a [J], a [Q], and a [K], change your Points to 66 and restore 2 Carrots.

relicDesc.cn: 抽牌时，若你的手牌中只有肖像牌，本轮点数上限+3，获得1巫术金块（每轮限3次）。
relicDesc.en: AT DRAW: If your hand only has court cards, Limit +3 (this round), Witchgeld +1. This effect can only trigger 3 times per round.

relicDesc.cn:
结算时，若你的手牌中有7，赋予牌库随机1张牌附术·回溯。
进入巫术商店时，你牌库中随机1张牌的点数变为7。
relicDesc.en:
AT TALLY: If your hand has [7] card(s), grant 1 random card in the deck the Revenant foil.
AT SHOPPE VISIT: Change 1 random card in your deck to [7].

relicDesc.cn:
结算时，若你的手牌中有7，获得2巫术金块。
若有≥2张7，赋予手牌中所有7附术·黄金。
relicDesc.en:
AT TALLY: If your hand has [7] card(s), Witchgeld +2. 
If your hand has ≥ 2 [7] cards, grant all [7] in your hand the Geld foil.

relicDesc.cn:
将你所有<7的数字牌点数+1，所有>7的数字牌点数-1。
进入巫术商店时，再次发动此效果。
relicDesc.en:
To all your ＜ 7 number cards, Pip +1. To all your ＞ 7 number cards, Pip -1.
AT SHOPPE VISIT: Trigger this effect again.

relicDesc.cn: 结算时，若你的点数恰好为21，将其翻倍，额外获得3巫术金块。
relicDesc.en: AT TALLY: If you have exactly 21 Points, double it, and get Witchgeld +3.

relicDesc.cn: 抽牌导致爆牌时，若点数≤24，阻止爆牌，将点数设置为21，并将牌库中随机1张牌的点数变为7。（每轮限1次）
relicDesc.en: AT DRAW: If a bust is triggered and your Points ≤ 24, ignore the bust, and change your Points to 21. Also change 1 random card in your deck to [7] (effect only applies 1 time per round).

relicDesc.cn:
结算时，若你的手牌中只有7，获得2张带有随机附术的7。
否则，将点数不为7的牌删除。
relicDesc.en:
AT TALLY: If your hand only has [7] cards, acquire 2 [7] cards with random foils.
IF NOT: Remove all non-[7] cards.

relicDesc.cn:
每当你获得1张卡牌，额外获得1张它的复制品。
立刻获得1张带有附术·回溯的A。
relicDesc.en:
Whenever you get 1 card, you gain 1 additional copy of it.
Immediately get 1 [A] with a Revenant foil.

relicDesc.cn:
点数上限-4
每当你获得1张牌，有50%概率使点数上限+1。
relicDesc.en:
Limit -4.
Whenever you get 1 card, there is a 50% chance to get Limit +1.

relicDesc.cn: 抽牌时，若你的牌库有≥12张牌，你可以查看3张牌，并从中选择1张作为本轮要抽的牌。
relicDesc.en: AT DRAW: If your deck has ≥ 12 cards, you can view 3 cards and choose 1 of them as the card to draw this round.

relicDesc.cn: 获得该祝福时，若你的牌库有≥12张牌，删除3张牌，获得3张带有随机附术的A。
relicDesc.en: WHEN ACQUIRED: If your deck has ≥ 12 cards, remove 3 cards, and get 3 [A] cards with random foils.

relicDesc.cn: 每轮开始时，你的牌库每有5张牌，本轮点数上限+2。
relicDesc.en: AT ROUND START: For every 5 cards in your deck, Limit +2 (this round).

relicDesc.cn: 结算时，牌库中每有3张未抽出的牌，本轮额外点数+1。
relicDesc.en: AT TALLY: For every 3 cards not yet drawn from the deck, Bonus +1 (this round).

relicDesc.cn:
首次获得该祝福时，选择一个花色。
随机将牌库中1张变为该花色，并使点数上限+1。
进入巫术商店时，重复该效果。
relicDesc.en:
WHEN FIRST ACQUIRED: Choose a suit, then change 1 random card in the deck to that suit. Limit +1.
AT SHOPPE VISIT: Trigger this effect again.

relicDesc.cn: 选择一个花色，每当你获得该花色的牌，点数上限+1，巫术金块+1。
relicDesc.en: Choose a suit. Whenever you get a card of that suit, Limit +1, Witchgeld +1.

relicDesc.cn: 结算时，若你手牌中所有牌花色相同，本轮额外点数+6，巫术金块+4。
relicDesc.en: AT TALLY: If every card in your hand has the same suit, Bonus +6 (this round), Witchgeld +4.

relicDesc.cn: 选择一个花色，每当你抽到该花色的牌，本轮点数上限+1，巫术金块+1。
relicDesc.en: Choose a suit. Whenever you draw a card of this suit, Limit +1 (this round), Witchgeld +1.

relicDesc.cn: 每轮开始时，若你牌库中所有牌花色相同，本轮额外点数+8。
relicDesc.en: AT ROUND START: If every card in your deck has the same suit, Bonus +8 (this round).

relicDesc.cn: 选择一个花色，每轮开始时，你牌库中每有2张该花色的牌，本轮点数上限+1，本轮额外点数+1。
relicDesc.en: Choose a suit. AT ROUND START: For every 2 cards in your deck of this suit, Limit +1 (this round), Bonus +1 (this round).

relicDesc.cn: 抽牌时，若你连续抽到相同花色的牌，本轮额外点数+1，巫术金块+1。
relicDesc.en: AT DRAW: When you consecutively draw a card of the same suit, Bonus +1 (this round), Witchgeld +1.

relicDesc.cn:
结算时，手牌中每有1种花色，本轮额外点数+1。
进入巫术商店时，赋予1张牌附术·多彩。
relicDesc.en:
AT TALLY: For every 1 suit in your hand, Bonus +1 (this round).
AT SHOPPE VISIT: Grant Prisma foil to 1 card.

relicDesc.cn:
抽牌时，若这张牌为红桃，本轮点数上限+1。
若这张牌为方片，本轮点数上限+1。
relicDesc.en:
AT DRAW: If a [♥] card is drawn, Limit +1 (this round).
If a [♦] card is drawn, Limit +1 (this round).

relicDesc.cn:
抽牌时，若这张牌为黑桃，本轮点数上限+1。
若这张牌为梅花，本轮点数上限+1。
relicDesc.en:
AT DRAW: If a [♠] card is drawn, Limit +1 (this round).
If a [♣] card is drawn, Limit +1 (this round).

relicDesc.cn:
抽牌时，若这张牌为红桃，本轮额外点数+1。
结算时，若你的手牌中有≥3张红桃牌，赋予你牌库中随机1张牌附术·多彩。
relicDesc.en:
AT DRAW: If a [♥] card is drawn, Bonus +1 (this round).
AT TALLY: If your hand has ≥ 3 [♥] cards, grant 1 random card in your deck the Prisma foil.

relicDesc.cn:
抽牌时，若这张牌为黑桃，本轮额外点数+1。
结算时，若你的手牌中有≥3张黑桃牌，使你牌库中随机2张数字牌的点数-1。
relicDesc.en:
AT DRAW: If a [♠] card is drawn, Bonus +1 (this round).
AT TALLY: If your hand has ≥ 3 [♠] cards, grant 2 random number cards in your deck Pip -1.

relicDesc.cn:
抽牌时，若这张牌为方片，本轮额外点数+1。
结算时，若你的手牌中有≥3张方片牌，点数上限+1。
relicDesc.en:
AT DRAW: If a [♦] card is drawn, Bonus +1 (this round).
AT TALLY: If your hand has ≥ 3 [♦] cards, Limit +1.

relicDesc.cn:
抽牌时，若这张牌为梅花，本轮额外点数+1。
结算时，若你的手牌中有≥3张梅花牌，获得1张带有附术·多彩的A。
relicDesc.en:
AT DRAW: If a [♣] card is drawn, Bonus +1 (this round).
AT TALLY: If your hand has ≥ 3 [♣] cards, get 1 [A] with the Prisma foil.

relicDesc.cn: 点数上限+4
relicDesc.en: Limit +4

relicDesc.cn: 额外点数+3
relicDesc.en: Bonus +3

relicDesc.cn: 结算时，巫术金块+3。
relicDesc.en: AT TALLY: Witchgeld +3.

relicDesc.cn:
赋予1张牌附术·黄金。
进入巫术商店时，重复该效果。
relicDesc.en:
Grant 1 card the Geld foil.
AT SHOPPE VISIT: Trigger this effect again.

relicDesc.cn:
附加祝福，不占用槽位
你的手牌上限始终为3张，当你抽取第4张牌时，会丢弃第1张牌。
relicDesc.en:
Added boon. Does not take up a slot.
Your hand always has 3 cards. When drawing a 4th card, discard the 1st card of your hand.

relicDesc.cn:
附加祝福，不占用槽位
点数上限+3
抽牌导致爆牌时，阻止爆牌，并将超出上限的部分变为你的当前点数（每轮限1次）。
relicDesc.en:
Added boon. Does not take up a slot.
Limit +3.
AT DRAW: If a bust is triggered, ignore the bust, and add the points exceeding the limit to your current Points instead (effect only applies 1 time per round).

relicDesc.cn:
附加祝福，不占用槽位
每次购买商品时，有50%概率使额外点数+1。
relicDesc.en:
Added boon. Does not take up a slot.
Every purchase has a 50% chance for Bonus +1.

relicDesc.cn:
附加祝福，不占用槽位
点数上限+6，额外点数+6，但你无法再获得巫术金块。
relicDesc.en:
Added boon. Does not take up a slot.
Limit +6, Bonus +6. You no longer get Witchgeld.
